title: Signed-language educational-package needs: five distinct profiles
scope: Bounded primary-source comparison for a worldwide educational-access paper; not a rank, allocation, translation or publication.

performed: selected original research and kit-content documents
not_performed: independent linguistic assessment of signed performances
inspection_contract.absence_rule: A blank index cell or failed retrieval is not global absence.

profiles.territory_frame: United States sources; no claim to enumerate Canadian or other ASL communities

population_evidence.observation: ACS language questions do not identify ASL users

profiles.population_inference: Unknown total and unknown stage-specific sign-using learners; hearing disability and English-at-home data are not substitute counts.

existing_provision.verified_scope: One-variable equations, fractions, grouping symbols; four linked practice types
Computing concepts and individual Repository video entry
limitations: not verified as a complete course

existing_provision.verified_scope: Eleven mathematics films, including word problems, calculus and statistics
254 articles, including 26 mathematics articles, and over 300 video hours
limitations: interpreted English, not representative ASL-first discourse

packages.title: Algebra-to-functions complete self-study course
packages.learner_group: ASL-using secondary pupils, returning adults and college entrants unable to study the subject comfortably through English alone
packages.full_route: Signed conceptual sequence, exact notation, worked examples, local exercises and answers
packages.smaller_route: Offline practice and answer companion to usable existing DeafTEC explanations
packages.mechanism: Connect conceptual explanation to independent application without fragmented navigation or connectivity
packages.comparison: Full course if prerequisite or signed problem explanation remains missing; companion if practice/offline access is the binding difference

packages.title: Executable computing and proof-reading modules
packages.learner_group: ASL-using IT learners, computing undergraduates and beginning research readers
packages.full_route: Complete introductory course with runnable examples and contextual signed explanation
packages.smaller_route: Contextual sign references, missing worked examples and answer rationales around an existing course
packages.mechanism: Technical terms acquire meaning through operations and proof structure, not dictionary lookup alone
packages.comparison: Compare contextual gaps and permitted reuse; corpus size is not complete course coverage

stage_candidates.foundation: Complete arithmetic/word-problem course for late-access learners; existing elementary videos weaken generic duplication
stage_candidates.practical_vocational: ASL-A or ASL-B according to actual course prerequisite
stage_candidates.research: ASL-B proof/counterexample and technical reading modules; existing interpreted STEM articles are counterevidence

modalities.text: English terminology and bilingual support, not an assumed adequate substitute
modalities.offline: full clips, indexes, exercises and rendering must be local; paid download route exists but reuse rights differ
modalities.ai: ASL-to-English server-based input exists; no verified complete autonomous signed lesson-production route in inspected sources

population_evidence.frame: respondents reporting at least some permanent hearing difficulty
a lot of hearing difficulty or unable to hear

profiles.population_inference: Subgroup estimate excludes hearing signers and other ages; neither knowledge nor its survey interval establishes academic usability. Do not multiply its rate by all-age hearing-disability totals.

existing_provision.verified_scope: Child-facing addition/subtraction and fraction operator examples; teacher-facing classification series distinguished
existing_provision.inspection: original production report and March 2025 content analysis with actual lesson V67

existing_provision.verified_scope: 2026 basic mathematics booklet, numeric-sign materials and scientific-work manual listed
limitations: not evidence of full statistics coverage

packages.title: Fraction-to-ratio visual course
packages.learner_group: Libras-using older primary pupils, secondary catch-up learners and adults applying quantities at work
packages.full_route: Integrated explanations, contrasting worked problems, progressive practice and answers
packages.smaller_route: Practice and answer sequence linked to usable MathLibras lessons
packages.mechanism: Build cumulative quantitative understanding and independent checking
packages.comparison: Substantial existing fractions provision weakens fresh disconnected explanations; full course remains conditional on sequence/practice/offline differences

packages.title: Bilingual research-data practicum
packages.learner_group: Libras-using university entrants and novice researchers interpreting data and uncertainty
packages.full_route: Datasets, code, signed concepts, worked analyses and answer rationales
packages.smaller_route: Probability and uncertainty concept/interpretation additions to an existing course
packages.mechanism: Connect academic data interpretation to executable and explainable analysis
packages.comparison: Academic products exist; complete independent statistics sequence and its absence globally are both unestablished

stage_candidates.foundation: LIB-A and distinct language/number foundations where needed

modalities.mathml: notation and structure, not signed grammar
modalities.offline: video/caption access not implied by PDF or YouTube link
modalities.ai: VLibras offers automatic avatars but its provider advises against replacement use in classes/courses

profiles.territory_frame: India; written-language repertoire must not be inferred from territory

population_evidence.frame: deaf persons as cited by ISLRTC from Census 2011

profiles.population_inference: Historical disability context only; sign proficiency and stage-specific learner totals unknown.

existing_provision.verified_scope: NCERT Classes I-VI advertised; actual maths page embeds Class VI and VII videos
limitations: topic contents and self-check answers uninspected

existing_provision.verified_scope: English 202 lessons with PDFs, signed links, learner guides and worksheets; several later signed-video cells blank
limitations: blank cell is only inspected-index omission
full video coverage and linguistic accuracy not assessed

packages.title: Secondary quantitative-continuity course
packages.learner_group: ISL-using adolescents and adult school-returners progressing beyond early NCERT resources
packages.full_route: Cumulative subject course with signed problems, explanation, worked practice and answers
packages.smaller_route: Exercise/answer and exact explanatory gap additions to existing concept videos
packages.mechanism: Continuity beyond already available school content
packages.comparison: Class VII is already represented; VIII-X coverage remains unestablished, not absent by default

packages.title: Programming-entry course
packages.learner_group: ISL-using vocational and first-year university learners, with an optional methods unit for beginning researchers
packages.full_route: Self-contained conceptual sequence, executable examples and answers
packages.smaller_route: Signed navigation and contextual explanation for a usable existing text course
packages.mechanism: Connect programming notation to conceptual instruction without assuming English/Hindi comfort
packages.comparison: NIOS demonstrates mixed-media architecture, not programming coverage or transported learning effects

stage_candidates.foundation: Complete accessible route through NCERT lessons; new beginning course remains eligible for late-access learners
stage_candidates.research: ISL-B methods/notebook unit; exact audience and alternatives unknown

modalities.sign: ISL, not signed Hindi or universal sign
modalities.text: actual learner's written-language repertoire; English technical labels where needed
modalities.offline: existing embeds do not establish downloadable complete courses
modalities.ai: mechanical content assembly feasible; no validated end-to-end ISL advanced lesson generator established by inspected evidence

profiles.territory_frame: Kenya; separate from other African sign languages and Korean KSL
profiles.population_inference: Unknown sign-user and stage-specific totals; hearing-disability count is context only.

existing_provision.verified_scope: Stories, vocabulary, comprehension questions, quizzes and identified episodes 026/009/011/022
existing_provision.inspection: actual provider episode index plus provider format descriptions
limitations: 337-item headline covers six sign languages, not KSL alone
viewership is not unique sign-user population or learning effect
does not establish offline availability of each signed video
not proof of a signed mathematics course
not proof of autonomous translation or learning effects

packages.title: Complete early bilingual literacy pathway
packages.learner_group: Primary children and late entrants acquiring KSL and written English or Kiswahili
packages.full_route: Story-based course with replayable signing, illustrated print and answer explanations
packages.smaller_route: Sequenced practice/answer booklet with stable existing-episode links
packages.mechanism: Connect receptive language and comprehension practice into a usable progression
packages.comparison: A generic new story collection is weakly additional; full offline course competes on actual local media and quiz availability

packages.title: Practical numeracy and digital records
packages.learner_group: KSL-using secondary catch-up and vocational learners
packages.full_route: Coherent explanations, everyday tasks and worked self-checks
packages.smaller_route: Task-specific signed interpretation and answers around existing resources
packages.mechanism: Connect quantities to practical record keeping and independent checking
packages.comparison: Literacy provision and a language curriculum neither establish nor disprove a complete practical numeracy course

stage_candidates.university: Corpus/data-methods reader: annotation, sampling, train/test separation, errors, uncertainty and reporting
stage_candidates.research: Same bounded reproducible methods reader using local KSL research baseline; target population unknown

modalities.offline: verify actual video and quiz assets, not app install alone
modalities.ai: local dataset/assessment research is not validated full-course generation; Korean KSL benchmarks are inapplicable

profiles.territory_frame: South Africa; preserve source labels when some linked literature examples say ASL

population_evidence.frame: generic Sign language category, language spoken most often in household
population_evidence.comparability: large unexplained discrepancy; no collapse-of-need inference

profiles.population_inference: No conversion to user counts; most-often household language is not individual proficiency or exact variety.

existing_provision.verified_scope: SASL stories, activities, books/DVDs, workbook/teacher guide and FET bridge
existing_provision.inspection: two-page detailed brochure and actual shop sample entries
limitations: paid supply does not prove universal home access

existing_provision.verified_scope: 2018 spring-school resources in Mathematical Literacy, English FAL and SASL HL
existing_provision.inspection: actual provider index; 59-page mathematical-literacy PDF identity resolved
limitations: internal PDF coverage uninspected after timeout

existing_provision.inspection: provider learner hub and topic lists
limitations: campus support and programme access not equivalent to open self-study
marketing assertions are not causal evidence

packages.title: Matric mathematical-literacy course
packages.learner_group: SASL-using secondary learners and adult qualification returners
packages.full_route: Complete conceptual sequence with realistic tasks, notation and self-check answers
packages.smaller_route: Exam-practice additions to an already usable explanatory course
packages.mechanism: Provide independent subject progression when revision alone does not supply prerequisites
packages.comparison: Directly compare existing DBE resources; failed internal retrieval does not prove a gap

packages.title: Digital-work and data-literacy course
packages.learner_group: SASL-using vocational and university entrants; optional data/academic-writing extension for graduate readers
packages.full_route: Independent offline course with signed explanation and executable tasks
packages.smaller_route: Troubleshooting and answer pack around accessible existing teaching
packages.mechanism: Extend independent access beyond institutional training routes without claiming their accreditation or placement outcomes
packages.comparison: Existing SASL training materially weakens broad absence claims; geographical/institutional reach remains unknown

stage_candidates.foundation: Home-use sequence around SLED literature competes with a complete newly authored bilingual reading course
stage_candidates.research: Data interpretation/academic writing; exact advanced mathematics edition and global absence unverified

modalities.sign: SASL rather than automatically relabelled ASL examples
modalities.offline: DVD kits establish a non-streaming alternative, not unrestricted redistribution
modalities.ai: mechanical assembly and provisional labelled assistance feasible; reliable autonomous SASL teaching generation not established

production_evidence.finding: Sign, captions, text and mathematical structure serve different roles; complete signing space and legibility must survive encoding
production_evidence.not_supported: MathML or written captions automatically confer signed-language comprehension

production_evidence.finding: 2026-08-12 ASL-to-English consumer input release; on-device landmarks with server translation
production_evidence.not_supported: Offline signing generation or proven coverage of all five languages

production_evidence.finding: Automatic Portuguese-to-Libras support exists; provider advises against course/class replacement use
Text/prompt-to-pose research with further video rendering; current page says model will not be open-sourced
production_evidence.not_supported: Ready unrestricted five-language autonomous textbook generator
production_evidence.identity_caution: KSL example is Korean, not Kenyan

conditional_comparison.q_definition: Fraction newly gaining specified usable access; gross gains, not net access change or test scores
conditional_comparison.formula: Compare B_F*q_F/C_F with B_S*q_S/C_S for full course F and smaller addition S
conditional_comparison.same_population_threshold: For the same B and positive denominators, F exceeds S when q_F/q_S > C_F/C_S
exclusions: No test-score SD or translation benchmark converted to access probability
